text:
Maya (PM): quick sync - we need to land launch criteria for the KMS/HSM work and the audit-log schema by EOW. customers are asking for per-tenant export + legal-hold support. can we outline must-haves vs stretch?
Jordan (Security): must-haves: SOC2 evidence for key rotation, immutable audit logs (append-only), searchable fields (user, tenant, action, request_id), retention compliance hooks (legal hold flag). stretch: per-tenant encrypted export + retention tiers.
Sam K (Eng): agree on must-haves. Implementation notes: HSM rotations -> record rotation evidence with sig + timestamp in audit log. For append-only we should use log-seq numbers and periodic snapshots to S3. rough plan: 2-week spike -> schema v1 -> 4-week rollout.
Lee (Infra): infra constraints: HSM provider has async rotation API, can take ~30s per-slot. need to avoid blocking inference paths. propose rotation proxy that streams rotation events into audit-stream (Kafka) and a background verifier service.
Jordan (Security): also: SOC2 auditors will want a chain-of-custody for keys and proof of rotation schedule enforcement. include automated alerting when rotation missed > drift_threshold.
Maya (PM): launch criteria proposal (draft): 1) rotation evidence stored and queryable for last 12 months; 2) audit log schema v1 documented + sample exports; 3) legal-hold flag that prevents deletion; 4) end-to-end test demonstrating per-tenant export (manual OK for v1) ; 5) security sign-off on threat model. Anything missing?
Sam K (Eng): add: performance SLO—rotation path zero impact on p99 inference for existing tenants (or documented fallback). if we can't meet 0 impact, must have an automatic fallback to previous key and an incident playbook.
Lee (Infra): +1. Also ops playbook for emergency key revocation + rollout steps. we should gate rollout by a feature flag per-tenant, and do small canary (5%) then 25% then global.
Compliance Bot: automated note: SOC2 evidence checklist updated -> https://confluence.internal/redwood/sec/kms-rotation-checklist. Attachments: sample-audit-schema-v1.json.
Ops Bot: retention config example (for discussion):
```
retention_policy:
  default_days: 365
  legal_hold_tag: "preserve"
  tenant_overrides:
    - tenant_id: T-12345
      days: 1825
```
Maya (PM): ok, so next steps: Sam/Lee pair on spike for rotation proxy (2w), Jordan to draft audit schema v1 + evidence samples (3d), I'll draft launch criteria doc and customer-facing FAQ (3d). can we commit by Friday? :eyes:
Jordan (Security): committing to draft schema by Thu EOD.
Sam K (Eng): spike kickoff tomorrow. will post tech notes in #eng-runtime.
Lee (Infra): will provision Kafka topic + storage for snapshots. ETA Fri.
Maya (PM): cool — if we hit blockers let's escalate in this thread. tagging @Jordan @Sam K @Lee. :thumbsup:
